graders.name: under-voice-length
graders.why: The email stays at or under 50 prose words. The voice's maximum is 40, and 50 allows a subject line. The input carries thanks and background that the default email shape includes and runs past 50 words.

graders.name: no-greeting
graders.why: The voice opens on the request, with no greeting or name line.

graders.name: no-sign-off
graders.why: The voice ends on the ask: the last line is no sign-off, thanks, or bare name.
